issues.description: The problem statement and the template repository consistently refer to the Course's teacher as the property/parameter named "instructor" (e.g. initializer Course(name:_, instructor:_, ...), property instructor). In the solution repository the Course class instead names this property/parameter "lecturer" (Course.lecturer, init parameter lecturer), while other parts of the solution (Client and Developer.attend) still use or pass/expect the name "instructor". This inconsistent identifier naming for the same conceptual entity (the person teaching the course) breaks the one-to-one mapping students must make from the problem text to the code and can cause confusion (and in the provided solution code, API mismatches).
issues.suggested_fix: Use a single consistent identifier for the Course's instructor across all artifacts. Prefer aligning the solution to the problem/template by renaming Course.lecturer and its initializer parameter to instructor (e.g. let instructor: String; init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) ) and update all references (Client instantiation and Developer.attend print) to use course.instructor. This preserves the problem wording and removes the mapping confusion.
